---
name: Localization issue
about: Missing/incorrect translation, RTL/LTR, or missing-key rendering
title: "[i18n] "
labels: localization
---

## Language

Which language; RTL or LTR.

## Problem

- [ ] Missing key (a raw key name like `bk.restore` shows instead of text)
- [ ] Wrong translation / awkward wording
- [ ] Layout breaks in this language (logical properties / direction)
- [ ] Placeholder/interpolation wrong (`{n}` params)

## Example

Screen (with the visible string), expected wording, and — if relevant — a
link to docs/LOCALIZATION.md + docs/HOW_TO_ADD_A_LANGUAGE.md.

Do not paste personal/user content beyond the visible UI string.
